## v1.10.0 — 2026-03-21

This release includes 3 features, 4 fixes across 26 commits.

### ✨ Features

- Production launch hardening for gates 7-12
- Add private @cullit/licensed package for paid tiers
- Wire reportUsage metering after successful generate

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Audit fixes — security, packaging, pricing, site accuracy
- Audit: align npm package messaging with actual distribution model; fix fake export docs; normalize nav CTA CSS
- Migrate lint config for eslint 10
- Resolve CI lint failure in markdown formatter test

### 🧹 Chores

- Harden readiness guards and local pre-push gate
- Sync legal text check with terms wording
- Align pricing checks with current markup
- Install playwright browser and honor pnpm config in docker
- Enforce lockfile consistency and fix CI install
- Type integration boundaries and bump version to 1.9.3
- Second lint pass to reduce warning noise in runtime code
- Reduce lint warnings below launch threshold
- Rename to architecture-docs and track in repo
- Rename cullit-docs -> cullit-ea; add EA docs audit workflow
- Remove internal architecture docs from public repo surface
- Add system flow diagrams and enforce doc sync policy
- Add Playwright dashboard tier gating smoke tests

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @dependabot[bot]
